paragraphs.text: When choosing a sleeping bag, check what seasons it’s for, as well as how heavy it is if you’re backpacking. Also think about the filling. Natural duck down is very warm, has a longer lifespan and is easier to pack up, while synthetic materials are easier to clean, and they quicker and are cheaper.
paragraphs.translation:
在选择睡袋时，要查看它适用于哪些季节，以及如果你要背包旅行，它的重量如何。
还要考虑填充物。
天然鸭绒非常保暖、使用寿命更长且更易于打包，而合成材料则更容易清洗、更快干且更便宜。

paragraphs.text: A Vango Fuse -12
paragraphs.translation: A款：Vango Fuse -12型睡袋

paragraphs.text: This all-year-round sleeping bag combines natural duck down and a new synthetic fibre. The result is a bag that’s warm and weighs 1.5kg.
paragraphs.translation:
这款四季适用的睡袋结合了天然羽绒和一种新型合成纤维。
结果是一款保暖且重量仅为1.5公斤的睡袋。

paragraphs.text: There’s a water-resistant finish to protect it from moisture.
paragraphs.translation: 它有一层防水涂层，以保护其免受湿气侵袭。

paragraphs.text: B Outwell Campi Lux Double Sleeping Bag
paragraphs.translation: B款 Outwell Campi Lux 双人睡袋

paragraphs.text: This double sleeping bag - which is suitable for all seasons except winter - is soft and cosy, and there’s a handy pocket for essentials, located inside near the top. It also folds up remarkably small, given its size.
paragraphs.translation:
这款双人睡袋——除了冬季外适用于所有季节——柔软舒适，并且在内部靠近顶部的位置设有一个方便存放必需品的小口袋。
考虑到它的尺寸，它还能折叠得非常小巧。

paragraphs.text: C Nordisk Oscar +10
paragraphs.translation: C 诺迪斯克 奥斯卡 +10 型号

paragraphs.text: At just 350g, this sleeping bag is remarkably light, and as it’s synthetic, it’s very easy to maintain. The pack size is just 13×20cm, which makes it ideal for backpacking. It will work perfectly for summer trekking.
paragraphs.translation:
这款睡袋仅重350克，非常轻便，而且由于是人造材料的，非常易于保养。
它的包装尺寸仅为13×20厘米，这使其成为背包旅行的理想选择。
它将非常适合夏季徒步旅行。

paragraphs.text: D The Big Sleep 250GSM Single Cowl Sleeping
paragraphs.translation: D 大眠250GSM单罩睡袋

paragraphs.text: If you want a no-frills, budget sleeping bag that will last more than one summer, opt for this. It’s soft, comfy and simple to wash. Give yourself a bit of time to fit it back in the bag, though. Use it for spring, summer and autumn.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你想要一个没有多余装饰、价格实惠且能使用超过一个夏天的睡袋，就选这款吧。
它柔软、舒适且易于清洗。
不过，需要花点时间才能把它装回袋子里。
适用于春季、夏季和秋季。

paragraphs.text: E Jack Wolfskin Smoozip +3
paragraphs.translation: E款 狼爪公司Smoozip +3型号睡袋

paragraphs.text: We like the extra insulation in this sleeping bag around the areas that tend to feel the cold (head, chest and feet). And the hood is cosy enough to use as a pillow.
paragraphs.translation:
我们喜欢这款睡袋在容易感到寒冷的部位（头部、胸部和脚部）增加的额外保暖层。
而且它的帽子非常舒适，足以当作枕头使用。

paragraphs.text: F Vang Star walker Dragon
paragraphs.translation: F Vang Star walker Dragon

paragraphs.text: This innovative, high-quality kids' sleeping bag enables you to undo some zips and turn it into a fun, animal-themed coat. Once your youngster is ready for bed, simply zip the bottom back on and zip up the shoulders. Suitable for between 8 and 20 degrees Celsius.
paragraphs.translation:
这款创新的高品质儿童睡袋可以让你解开一些拉链，将其变成一件有趣的动物主题外套。
一旦你的孩子准备好睡觉，只需将底部拉链拉回并拉上肩部拉链即可。
适用于8到20摄氏度的温度范围。

paragraphs.text: G Out well conqueror
paragraphs.translation: G 款：Outwell 征服者

paragraphs.text: This sleeping bag has an integrated down duvet and lots of space. What’s more, it packs up compactly and is easy to get back in the bag. It’s light but too big for a rucksack.
paragraphs.translation:
这款睡袋带有内置羽绒被，且空间充足。
此外，它收纳紧凑，且容易放回袋中。
它很轻，但对于背包来说太大了。

paragraphs.text: The Spread the Word Life Writing Prize
paragraphs.translation: “传播文字”生活写作奖

paragraphs.text: We are delighted to announce The Spread the Word Life Writing Prize in association with Goldsmiths Writers’ Centre.
paragraphs.translation:
“传播文字”生活写作奖
我们很高兴地宣布，与金匠写作中心联合设立斯普雷德·泽·沃德生活写作奖。

paragraphs.text: Competition Rules
paragraphs.translation: 竞赛规则

paragraphs.text: Entries should be original works of life writing of no more than 5,000 words. The word count will be checked and entries longer than 5,000 words will be disqualified. There is no minimum word count.
paragraphs.translation:
参赛作品应为原创的生活写作作品，字数不超过5000字。
将核实字数，超过5000字的参赛作品将被取消资格。
没有最低字数限制。

paragraphs.text: For the purposes of the Prize, Life Writing is defined as non-fiction and should be based on a significant portion from the author’s own experience. Traditional biographies, where the piece is only about the experience of someone else, are excluded.
paragraphs.translation:
就本奖项而言，生命写作被定义为非虚构类作品，且应基于作者自身经历的重要部分。
传统传记作品，即仅涉及他人经历的内容，被排除在外。

paragraphs.text: Writers only submit one entry each. Multiple entries by the same author will result in only the first entry being considered for the Prize and any additional entries disqualified. Writers who have previously won or been highly commended in the Life Writing Prize are excluded from entering; otherwise, previous entrants may submit.
paragraphs.translation:
每位作者仅限提交一份参赛作品。
同一作者提交多份作品将导致只有第一份作品被纳入奖项考虑，而其他附加作品将被取消资格。
曾在该生活写作奖中获奖或获得高度赞扬的作者不得再参赛；除此之外，以往的参赛者可以提交作品。

paragraphs.text: Entries must be the original, previously unpublished work of the entrant. Graphic novel-style entries, where drawings or photographs accompany text, are welcome. Entries can be self-contained pieces of life writing, or the first 5,000 words of a longer piece of work.
paragraphs.translation:
参赛作品必须是参赛者的原创且先前未发表的作品。
欢迎以图文小说形式提交的作品，其中附有绘画或照片以补充文字。
参赛作品可以是独立完整的生活写作片段，也可以是较长作品的前5000字。

paragraphs.text: The Life Writing Prize is open to writers aged over 18 and resident in the UK who are emerging writers, which means they have not previously published in print a full-length work. We define a full-length work as, for example, a complete work of fiction or non-fiction over 30 000 words.
paragraphs.translation:
生活写作奖面向18岁以上、居住在英国且处于起步阶段的作家开放，这意味着他们此前未曾以印刷形式出版过任何完整长度的作品。
我们将完整长度作品定义为，例如，超过3万字的完整小说或非虚构作品。

paragraphs.text: Entries that are simultaneously submitted elsewhere are welcome - but please let us know as soon as possible if a piece is to be published elsewhere or has won another prize so we can disqualify it from the Life Writing Prize.
paragraphs.translation: 欢迎同时向其他投稿的作品，但若作品即将在其他地方发表或已获得其他奖项，请尽快告知我们，以便我们将其从生命写作奖中取消资格。

paragraphs.text: The winner will receive ￡1,500 publication on Spread the Word’s website, two years’ membership of the Royal Society of Literature，and a development meeting with an editor and an agent. Two highly commended entries will receive £500 and two mentoring sessions, a development meeting with an editor and an agent, and be published on the Spread the Word website.
paragraphs.translation:
获胜者将获得1500英镑，其作品将在“传播文字”网站上出版，并获得皇家文学学会两年会员资格，以及与一位编辑和一位经纪人进行一次发展会议。
两个高度推荐的作品将获得500英镑和两次指导会议、与一位编辑和一位经纪人进行一次发展会议，并将在“传播文字”网站上出版。

sentence_translations.sentence: The Spread the Word Life Writing Prize
sentence_translations.translation: “传播文字”生活写作奖

sentence_translations.sentence: We are delighted to announce The Spread the Word Life Writing Prize in association with Goldsmiths Writers’ Centre.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们很高兴地宣布，与金匠写作中心联合设立斯普雷德·泽·沃德生活写作奖。

sentence_translations.sentence: Competition Rules
sentence_translations.translation: 竞赛规则

sentence_translations.sentence: Entries should be original works of life writing of no more than 5,000 words.
sentence_translations.translation: 参赛作品应为原创的生活写作作品，字数不超过5000字。

sentence_translations.sentence: The word count will be checked and entries longer than 5,000 words will be disqualified.
sentence_translations.translation: 将核实字数，超过5000字的参赛作品将被取消资格。

sentence_translations.sentence: There is no minimum word count.
sentence_translations.translation: 没有最低字数限制。

sentence_translations.sentence: For the purposes of the Prize, Life Writing is defined as non-fiction and should be based on a significant portion from the author’s own experience.

sentence_translations.sentence: Traditional biographies, where the piece is only about the experience of someone else, are excluded.

sentence_translations.sentence: Writers only submit one entry each.

sentence_translations.sentence: Multiple entries by the same author will result in only the first entry being considered for the Prize and any additional entries disqualified.

sentence_translations.sentence: Writers who have previously won or been highly commended in the Life Writing Prize are excluded from entering; otherwise, previous entrants may submit.
sentence_translations.translation: 曾在该生活写作奖中获奖或获得高度赞扬的作者不得再参赛；除此之外，以往的参赛者可以提交作品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Entries must be the original, previously unpublished work of the entrant.
sentence_translations.translation: 参赛作品必须是参赛者的原创且先前未发表的作品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Graphic novel-style entries, where drawings or photographs accompany text, are welcome.

sentence_translations.sentence: Entries can be self-contained pieces of life writing, or the first 5,000 words of a longer piece of work.

sentence_translations.sentence: The Life Writing Prize is open to writers aged over 18 and resident in the UK who are emerging writers, which means they have not previously published in print a full-length work.

sentence_translations.sentence: We define a full-length work as, for example, a complete work of fiction or non-fiction over 30 000 words.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们将完整长度作品定义为，例如，超过3万字的完整小说或非虚构作品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Entries that are simultaneously submitted elsewhere are welcome - but please let us know as soon as possible if a piece is to be published elsewhere or has won another prize so we can disqualify it from the Life Writing Prize.
sentence_translations.translation: 欢迎同时向其他投稿的作品，但若作品即将在其他地方发表或已获得其他奖项，请尽快告知我们，以便我们将其从生命写作奖中取消资格。

sentence_translations.sentence: The winner will receive ￡1,500 publication on Spread the Word’s website, two years’ membership of the Royal Society of Literature，and a development meeting with an editor and an agent.

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Encouraging employees to be healthy: a guide for employers

paragraphs.text: Benefits
paragraphs.translation: 益处

paragraphs.text: Putting effort into employee wellness can reduce absenteeism and encourage better teamwork in the workplace, as well as increased productivity. Once you’ve devised a program, continue to assess the outcomes and regularly survey your team to gather feedback.
paragraphs.translation:
致力于员工健康能够减少缺勤率，促进工作场所中更好的团队合作，同时提高生产力。
一旦制定了计划，应持续评估结果，并定期调查团队以收集反馈。

paragraphs.text: Focus on general prevention
paragraphs.translation: 关注整体预防

paragraphs.text: Consider offering flu vaccinations on site and look at offering employees incentives on health insurance. Some companies arrange for someone who specialises in health issues, such as a doctor, to visit the workplace and speak to employees.
paragraphs.translation:
考虑在工作场所提供流感疫苗接种，并尝试为员工提供健康保险方面的激励措施。
一些公司会安排健康问题专家（如医生）到访工作场所，并与员工进行交流。

paragraphs.text: Encourage a healthier diet
paragraphs.translation: 鼓励更健康的饮食

paragraphs.text: Most of us know that eating healthily can help prevent future diseases, but many are not aware that unhealthy eating is linked to a 66 percent increased risk of loss of productivity. It may be necessary to consciously develop a healthy food and drink workplace policy, including a healthy catering policy. A simple thing to do is substitute soda in any on-site vending machines with water or juice. Also investigate the nutritional value of food supplied for team meetings and work events. Consider putting a bowl of fruit out in the staff room and urge everyone to help themselves for free. You can encourage employees to bring in healthy lunches from home by making sure that there is a fridge in the break room.
paragraphs.translation:
我们大多数人都知道健康饮食有助于预防未来的疾病，但许多人并未意识到，不健康饮食与生产力损失风险增加66%有关。
可能有必要有意识地制定一项关于健康食品和饮料的工作场所政策，包括健康的餐饮政策。
一个简单的做法是，将现场任何自动售货机中的汽水替换为水或果汁。
此外，还要调查为团队会议和工作活动提供的食品的营养价值。
考虑在员工休息室放一碗水果，并鼓励大家免费自行取用。
你可以通过确保休息室里有冰箱，来鼓励员工从家里带来健康的午餐。

paragraphs.text: Encourage regular exercise
paragraphs.translation: 鼓励定期锻炼

paragraphs.text: Encouraging employees to exercise needn’t be expensive as there are plenty of low-cost methods available. These might include: installing racks for bikes in your staff car park; encouraging employees to take pa in fun runs and charity events; suggesting 'walking meetings’ where people discuss business as they get fresh air and exercise; and putting in showers to assist those who ride or run to the workplace. Some companies negotiate group rates for their employees at a nearby gym.
paragraphs.translation:
鼓励员工锻炼不一定要花费高昂，因为有许多低成本的方法可供选择。
一些公司会为员工协商附近健身房的团体优惠价格。

paragraphs.text: Improve mental health
paragraphs.translation: 改善心理健康

paragraphs.text: Recent reports have shown that ignoring mental health costs Australian companies at least $11 billion a year. We all have a responsibility to look out for one another. Some ways you can do this in the workplace include: running employee surveys to get valuable information on morale in the workplace; training managers on mental health strategies; offering rebates so employees are compensated for counselling if required; and refusing to accept any bullying and unprofessional behaviour in your workplace.
paragraphs.translation:
最新报告显示，忽视精神健康每年给澳大利亚企业造成至少110亿美元的损失。
我们每个人都有责任相互关照。
在工作场所实现这一目标的一些方法包括：开展员工调查以获取关于工作士气的宝贵信息；对管理人员进行精神健康策略培训；提供补贴，以便员工在需要时获得心理咨询费用的补偿；以及拒绝接受工作场所中的任何欺凌和不专业行为。

paragraphs.text: Marama Beach Hotel and Bistro: guidelines for working in the kitchen
paragraphs.translation: 玛拉玛海滩酒店与小酒馆：厨房工作指南

paragraphs.text: The health and well-being of customers and staff is our first priority, and we expect all staff to take every step possible to maintain food safety and work in a hygienic manner.
paragraphs.translation: 顾客和员工的健康与福祉是我们的首要任务，我们期望所有员工采取一切可能的措施来维护食品安全并以卫生的方式工作。

paragraphs.text: Hygiene
paragraphs.translation: 卫生

paragraphs.text: · Long hair must be tied back and no rings may be worn if touching food.
paragraphs.translation: 长发必须束起，并且在接触食物时不得佩戴戒指。

paragraphs.text: · The regulation chefs' shirts and trousers are to be freshly laundered before starting a new shift, along with aprons if they are worn.
paragraphs.translation: · 厨师的标准衬衫和裤子必须在开始新班次前洗净，如果穿戴围裙，也应如此。

paragraphs.text: · Cross-contamination between raw and cooked food must be avoided. To this end, staff must use a clean board each time they cut different types of food.
paragraphs.translation:
必须避免生食与熟食之间的交叉污染。
为此，员工每次切割不同类型的食物时，必须使用干净的砧板。

paragraphs.text: · Staff should not touch money and then food without washing their hands in between.
paragraphs.translation: 员工在接触钱币后、触碰食物前，必须洗手，否则不得在两者之间交替操作。

paragraphs.text: · In the case of illness or a skin problem, the staff member should inform the manager. Cuts on hands and arms must be properly wrapped or bandaged.
paragraphs.translation:
如果员工生病或出现皮肤问题，应通知经理。
手部和手臂上的伤口必须妥善包扎或缠上绷带。

paragraphs.text: Safety rules
paragraphs.translation: 安全规则

paragraphs.text: · All injuries must be reported to management immediately.
paragraphs.translation: · 所有受伤事件必须立即向管理层报告。

paragraphs.text: · Safety guards must not be altered in any way, and staff must always wear protective clothing and gloves when working with sharp, hot, cold or corrosive items or materials.
paragraphs.translation: 安全防护装置不得以任何方式改动，员工在处理锋利、高温、低温或腐蚀性物品或材料时，必须始终穿戴防护服和手套。

paragraphs.text: · Loose clothing or jewellery must not be worn.
paragraphs.translation: 不得穿着宽松的衣物或佩戴首饰。

paragraphs.text: · Defective appliances must be turned off and not used - staff must not to fix them themselves.
paragraphs.translation: · 有缺陷的设备必须关闭且不得使用——员工不得自行修理。

paragraphs.text: · Heavy boxes should be lifted carefully with bent knees and a straight back, holding the box close to the body.
paragraphs.translation: · 搬运重物时应弯曲膝盖、挺直背部，小心抬起，并将箱子紧贴身体。

paragraphs.text: · Work areas should be clean and free of hazards.
paragraphs.translation: 工作区域应保持清洁，且无安全隐患。

paragraphs.text: · Spills on the floor must be dealt with immediately.
paragraphs.translation: · 地板上的液体溅洒必须立即处理。

paragraphs.text: · Flammable liquids must be stored away from flames.
paragraphs.translation: · 易燃液体必须远离明火存放。

paragraphs.text: · If storing containers of chemicals in the kitchen, they must have clear labels so as to avoid any confusion about the contents.
paragraphs.translation: · 如果在厨房内存放化学品容器，它们必须带有清晰的标签，以避免对内容物产生任何混淆。

paragraphs.text: Breaks

Staff have 20 minutes of paid break time per 3 hours of work, during which time they may not leave the premises. Every staff member who works a shift exceeding 5 hours is entitled to a 30-minute unpaid break and free meals. However, please be aware that the kitchen may not always be able to provide this service, especially in peak times. Beverages kept in the storeroom may not be consumed by staff, but filtered water is provided free of charge in the staff room.
paragraphs.translation:
员工每工作3小时可享受20分钟的带薪休息时间，期间不得离开工作场所。
每名工作班次超过5小时的员工有权享有30分钟的无薪休息时间及免费餐食。
但请注意，厨房可能无法随时提供此项服务，尤其是在高峰时段。
存放在储藏室的饮品员工不得饮用，但员工休息室免费提供过滤水。

但请注意，厨房可能无法始终提供此项服务，尤其是在高峰时段。

parts.source_article_title: Encouraging employees to be healthy: a guide for employers

sentence_translations.sentence: Benefits
sentence_translations.translation: 益处

sentence_translations.sentence: Putting effort into employee wellness can reduce absenteeism and encourage better teamwork in the workplace, as well as increased productivity.
sentence_translations.translation: 致力于员工健康能够减少缺勤率，促进工作场所中更好的团队合作，同时提高生产力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Once you’ve devised a program, continue to assess the outcomes and regularly survey your team to gather feedback.
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦制定了计划，应持续评估结果，并定期调查团队以收集反馈。

sentence_translations.sentence: Focus on general prevention
sentence_translations.translation: 关注整体预防

sentence_translations.sentence: Consider offering flu vaccinations on site and look at offering employees incentives on health insurance.
sentence_translations.translation: 考虑在工作场所提供流感疫苗接种，并尝试为员工提供健康保险方面的激励措施。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some companies arrange for someone who specialises in health issues, such as a doctor, to visit the workplace and speak to employees.
sentence_translations.translation: 一些公司会安排健康问题专家（如医生）到访工作场所，并与员工进行交流。

sentence_translations.sentence: Encourage a healthier diet
sentence_translations.translation: 鼓励更健康的饮食

sentence_translations.sentence: Most of us know that eating healthily can help prevent future diseases, but many are not aware that unhealthy eating is linked to a 66 percent increased risk of loss of productivity.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们大多数人都知道健康饮食有助于预防未来的疾病，但许多人并未意识到，不健康饮食与生产力损失风险增加66%有关。

sentence_translations.sentence: It may be necessary to consciously develop a healthy food and drink workplace policy, including a healthy catering policy.
sentence_translations.translation: 可能有必要有意识地制定一项关于健康食品和饮料的工作场所政策，包括健康的餐饮政策。

sentence_translations.sentence: A simple thing to do is substitute soda in any on-site vending machines with water or juice.
sentence_translations.translation: 一个简单的做法是，将现场任何自动售货机中的汽水替换为水或果汁。

sentence_translations.sentence: Also investigate the nutritional value of food supplied for team meetings and work events.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，还要调查为团队会议和工作活动提供的食品的营养价值。

sentence_translations.sentence: Consider putting a bowl of fruit out in the staff room and urge everyone to help themselves for free.
sentence_translations.translation: 考虑在员工休息室放一碗水果，并鼓励大家免费自行取用。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can encourage employees to bring in healthy lunches from home by making sure that there is a fridge in the break room.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以通过确保休息室里有冰箱，来鼓励员工从家里带来健康的午餐。

sentence_translations.sentence: Encourage regular exercise
sentence_translations.translation: 鼓励定期锻炼

sentence_translations.sentence: Encouraging employees to exercise needn’t be expensive as there are plenty of low-cost methods available.
sentence_translations.translation: 鼓励员工锻炼不一定要花费高昂，因为有许多低成本的方法可供选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: These might include: installing racks for bikes in your staff car park; encouraging employees to take part in fun runs and charity events; suggesting 'walking meetings’ where people discuss business as they get fresh air and exercise; and putting in showers to assist those who ride or run to the workplace.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些方法可能包括：在员工停车场安装自行车架；鼓励员工参加趣味跑步和慈善活动；建议开展“步行会议”，让员工在呼吸新鲜空气和锻炼的同时讨论业务；以及安装淋浴设施，以方便骑自行车或跑步上班的员工。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some companies negotiate group rates for their employees at a nearby gym.
sentence_translations.translation: 一些公司会为员工协商附近健身房的团体优惠价格。

sentence_translations.sentence: Improve mental health
sentence_translations.translation: 改善心理健康

sentence_translations.sentence: Recent reports have shown that ignoring mental health costs Australian companies at least $11 billion a year.
sentence_translations.translation: 最新报告显示，忽视精神健康每年给澳大利亚企业造成至少110亿美元的损失。

sentence_translations.sentence: We all have a responsibility to look out for one another.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们每个人都有责任相互关照。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some ways you can do this in the workplace include: running employee surveys to get valuable information on morale in the workplace; training managers on mental health strategies; offering rebates so employees are compensated for counselling if required; and refusing to accept any bullying and unprofessional behaviour in your workplace.
sentence_translations.translation: 在工作场所实现这一目标的一些方法包括：开展员工调查以获取关于工作士气的宝贵信息；对管理人员进行精神健康策略培训；提供补贴，以便员工在需要时获得心理咨询费用的补偿；以及拒绝接受工作场所中的任何欺凌和不专业行为。

sentence_translations.sentence: Marama Beach Hotel and Bistro: guidelines for working in the kitchen
sentence_translations.translation: 玛拉玛海滩酒店与小酒馆：厨房工作指南

sentence_translations.sentence: The health and well-being of customers and staff is our first priority, and we expect all staff to take every step possible to maintain food safety and work in a hygienic manner.
sentence_translations.translation: 顾客和员工的健康与福祉是我们的首要任务，我们期望所有员工采取一切可能的措施来维护食品安全并以卫生的方式工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Hygiene
sentence_translations.translation: 卫生

sentence_translations.sentence: Long hair must be tied back and no rings may be worn if touching food.
sentence_translations.translation: 长发必须束起，并且在接触食物时不得佩戴戒指。

sentence_translations.sentence: · The regulation chefs' shirts and trousers are to be freshly laundered before starting a new shift, along with aprons if they are worn.
sentence_translations.translation: · 厨师的标准衬衫和裤子必须在开始新班次前洗净，如果穿戴围裙，也应如此。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Cross-contamination between raw and cooked food must be avoided.
sentence_translations.translation: 必须避免生食与熟食之间的交叉污染。

sentence_translations.sentence: To this end, staff must use a clean board each time they cut different types of food.
sentence_translations.translation: 为此，员工每次切割不同类型的食物时，必须使用干净的砧板。

sentence_translations.sentence: Staff should not touch money and then food without washing their hands in between.
sentence_translations.translation: 员工在接触钱币后、触碰食物前，必须洗手，否则不得在两者之间交替操作。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the case of illness or a skin problem, the staff member should inform the manager.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果员工生病或出现皮肤问题，应通知经理。

sentence_translations.sentence: Cuts on hands and arms must be properly wrapped or bandaged.
sentence_translations.translation: 手部和手臂上的伤口必须妥善包扎或缠上绷带。

sentence_translations.sentence: Safety rules
sentence_translations.translation: 安全规则

sentence_translations.sentence: · All injuries must be reported to management immediately.
sentence_translations.translation: · 所有受伤事件必须立即向管理层报告。

sentence_translations.sentence: Safety guards must not be altered in any way, and staff must always wear protective clothing and gloves when working with sharp, hot, cold or corrosive items or materials.
sentence_translations.translation: 安全防护装置不得以任何方式改动，员工在处理锋利、高温、低温或腐蚀性物品或材料时，必须始终穿戴防护服和手套。

sentence_translations.sentence: Loose clothing or jewellery must not be worn.
sentence_translations.translation: 不得穿着宽松的衣物或佩戴首饰。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Defective appliances must be turned off and not used - staff must not to fix them themselves.
sentence_translations.translation: · 有缺陷的设备必须关闭且不得使用——员工不得自行修理。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Heavy boxes should be lifted carefully with bent knees and a straight back, holding the box close to the body.
sentence_translations.translation: · 搬运重物时应弯曲膝盖、挺直背部，小心抬起，并将箱子紧贴身体。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Work areas should be clean and free of hazards.
sentence_translations.translation: 工作区域应保持清洁，且无安全隐患。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Spills on the floor must be dealt with immediately.
sentence_translations.translation: · 地板上的液体溅洒必须立即处理。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Flammable liquids must be stored away from flames.
sentence_translations.translation: · 易燃液体必须远离明火存放。

sentence_translations.sentence: · If storing containers of chemicals in the kitchen, they must have clear labels so as to avoid any confusion about the contents.
sentence_translations.translation: · 如果在厨房内存放化学品容器，它们必须带有清晰的标签，以避免对内容物产生任何混淆。

sentence_translations.sentence: Staff have 20 minutes of paid break time per 3 hours of work, during which time they may not leave the premises.
sentence_translations.translation: 员工每工作3小时可享受20分钟的带薪休息时间，期间不得离开工作场所。

sentence_translations.sentence: Every staff member who works a shift exceeding 5 hours is entitled to a 30-minute unpaid break and free meals.
sentence_translations.translation: 每名工作班次超过5小时的员工有权享有30分钟的无薪休息时间及免费餐食。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, please be aware that the kitchen may not always be able to provide this service, especially in peak times.
sentence_translations.translation: 但请注意，厨房可能无法随时提供此项服务，尤其是在高峰时段。

parts.title: Passage 3
parts.article_title: A home-sewing revival: the return of Clothkits

paragraphs.text: In the 1970s, Clothkits revolutionised home sewing. Later, a woman from Sussex, England, revived the nostalgic brand and brought it up to date
paragraphs.translation:
在20世纪70年代，Clothkits彻底改变了家庭缝纫方式。
后来，一位来自英格兰苏塞克斯的女性复兴了这个怀旧品牌，并将其更新换代。

paragraphs.text: A

I can't remember many of the clothes I wore before I was six, but I have a vivid memory of a certain skirt whose patterns I can still trace in my mind. It was wraparound, with a belt that threaded through itself, decorated with cats in two shades of green.
paragraphs.translation:
我记不得六岁前穿过的许多衣服，但我对某条裙子有着清晰的记忆，其图案我仍能在脑海中勾勒出来。
这是一条裹身裙，配有一条自穿的腰带，上面装饰着两只深浅不同的绿色的猫。

paragraphs.text: I wore it with a knitted red jersey my mum bought in a jumble sale, and brown sandals with flowers cut into the toes.
paragraphs.translation: 我搭配它穿了一件妈妈在旧物义卖中买来的红色针织衫，以及一双鞋头刻有花朵图案的棕色凉鞋。

paragraphs.text: It was 1979, and I was not yet five. I forgot about that skirt for long time, but when a girlfriend mentioned the name Clothkits while we were chatting, it was as if a door suddenly opened on a moment in the past that resonated with vivid significance for me.’
paragraphs.translation:
那是1979年，我还不满五岁。
那条裙子被我遗忘了很久，但是当一个女性朋友在我们聊天时提到Clothkits这个品牌名时，仿佛一扇门突然打开，通往一个对我意义深远、历历在目的过往瞬间。

paragraphs.text: The brand, founded in 1968, had by the late 1980s mostly vanished from people’s lives, but by a combination of determination and luck Kay Mawer brought it back.
paragraphs.translation: 该品牌成立于1968年，到20世纪80年代末已基本从人们的生活中消失，但凭借决心与运气的结合，凯·马沃尔将其重新带回。

paragraphs.text: B

Clothkits was created by the designer Anne Kennedy, who came up with the ingenious idea of printing a pattern straight on to coloured fabric so that a paper pattern was not needed. It was accompanied by instructions that almost anyone could follow on how to cut the pieces out and sew them together. ’I was rebelling against the formulaic lines of textile design at that time,’ Kennedy says. ’My interest was in folk art and clothes that were simple to make as I had lots of unfinished sewing disasters in my cupboard.’ Clothkits has always embodied the spirit of the late 1960s and 1970s. Its initial design was a dress in a geometric stripe in orange, pink, turquoise and purple. It cost 25 shillings (£1.25), and after it was featured in the Observer newspaper, Kennedy received more than ￡2,000 worth of orders. She ran the company from Lewes in Sussex, where at its peak it employed more than 400 people, selling to 44 countries worldwide. Sew-your-own kits formed the core of the business, supplemented by knitwear. Kennedy’s children demonstrated the patterns by wearing them in photographs.
paragraphs.translation:
Clothkits 由设计师安妮·肯尼迪创立，她提出了一个巧妙的主意：将图案直接印在彩色布料上，从而无需纸质纸样。
该品牌还附带了几乎人人都能遵循的说明，指导如何裁剪布料并将它们缝制在一起。
“我当时在反抗那时纺织品设计中公式化的线条，”肯尼迪说。
“我的兴趣在于民间艺术和易于制作的衣物，因为我柜子里有很多未完成的缝纫失败品。”
Clothkits 始终体现了20世纪60年代末和70年代的精神。
其最初的设计是一条带有橙色、粉色、蓝绿色和紫色几何条纹的连衣裙。
它的价格为25先令（1.25英镑），在被《观察家报》报道后，肯尼迪收到了价值超过2000英镑的订单。
她在苏塞克斯郡的刘易斯经营这家公司，公司鼎盛时期雇佣了400多名员工，产品销售到全球44个国家。
自助缝纫套件构成了业务的核心，并辅以针织品。
肯尼迪的孩子们在照片中亲自穿着这些款式，以此作为展示。

paragraphs.text: C

Kennedy sold the company in the late 1980s. There had been a few administrative problems with postal strikes and a new computer system, which back then took up an entire room,’but the times were changing as well,’ she says. ’More women were going out to work and sewing less for their children She sold the company to one of her suppliers, who then sold it on to Freeman’s, which ran Clothkits along side its own and for a while, using Kennedy’s impressive database, but its ethos as a big, corporate company did not sit well alongside the alternative and Clrtistic values of Clothkits. In 1991, Clothkits was made dormant, and there the story might have ended, were it not for Mawer fascination with discovering what happened to Clothkits.
paragraphs.translation:
肯尼迪在20世纪80年代末出售了公司。
她表示，由于邮政罢工和新计算机系统（当时占据整个房间）出现了一些行政问题，“但时代也在变化。”
“更多女性外出工作，为孩子缝制衣物变少。”她将公司卖给了一位供应商，后者又将其转售给弗里曼公司。弗里曼一度利用肯尼迪出色的数据库，与自家业务并行运营Clothkits，但作为大型企业，其企业精神与Clothkits所倡导的非主流及艺术价值观格格不入。

paragraphs.text: D

Mawer’s mother bought her a sewing machine when she was ten and taught her basic pattern-cutting and garment construction, encouraging her experiment with colour and design by trial and error. The first garment Mawer made was a pair of trousers, which she made by tracing around an existing pair of trousers. In her late twenties, she spent five years working on digital and sculptural installations. ’It was an amazing, mind-expanding experience, but I knew it was unlikely I could make a living as a practising artist. I was definitely looking for a way that I could work in a creative industry with a commercial edge.’ The experience inspired Mawer to return to education, studying for a degree in fine art at the University of Chichester. Her passion for vintage fabric, which her mother had encouraged her to start collecting, led her back Clothkits, and from there to a journey into the heart of Freeman’s. Negotiations with the company took 18 months, but in October 2007 Clothkits was hers.
paragraphs.translation:
Mawer的母亲在她十岁时给她买了一台缝纫机，并教她基本的裁剪和服装制作技巧，鼓励她通过反复尝试来实验色彩与设计。
Mawer制作的第一件衣物是一条裤子，她是通过描摹一条现有裤子的轮廓来完成的。
在她二十多岁快三十岁时，她花了五年时间从事数字和雕塑装置艺术工作。
“那是一段令人惊叹、开阔眼界的经历，但我知道作为一名职业艺术家谋生是不太可能的。”
“我确实在寻找一种方式，能够让我在具有商业优势的创意产业中工作。”
这段经历激励Mawer重返校园，在奇切斯特大学攻读美术学位。
她对复古布料的热爱——母亲曾鼓励她开始收藏——引导她回到了Clothkits，并由此踏上了一段深入Freeman’s公司的旅程。
与公司的谈判历时18个月，但最终在2007年10月，Clothkits归她所有。

paragraphs.text: E

The ethos of Clothkits remains the same, and Mawer is proud that her fabric is printed either in London or the north of England, and that packaging is kept to an absolute minimum. ’ I wanted to feel that everyone involved in the brand, from design to production, was part of a process I could witness. I couldn’t see the point of manufacturing on the other side of the world, as that’s not what Clothkits has ever been about.’ The revival of Clothkits has also, of course, coincided with a growing sense of dissatisfaction at our disposable society, and the resulting resurgence of interest in skills such as sewing and knitting. ’Making your own clothes gives you a greater appreciation of the craftsmanship in the construction of a garment,’ Mawer says. ’When you know the process involved in making a skirt, treasure it in a way you wouldn’t if you'd bought it from a massproducing manufacturer.’
paragraphs.translation:
Clothkits 的理念保持不变，Mawer 自豪于她的面料是在伦敦或英格兰北部印制的，并且包装被控制在最低限度。
“我希望与这个品牌相关的每个人，从设计到生产，都是我可以见证的过程的一部分。”
我不认为在世界另一端生产有任何意义，因为那从来都不是 Clothkits 的宗旨。”
当然，Clothkits 的复兴也恰逢人们对我们这个一次性社会的不满日益增长，以及随之而来的对缝纫和编织等技能兴趣的复苏。
“自己制作衣服会让你更欣赏一件衣物构造中的工艺，”Mawer 说道。
“当你了解制作一条裙子所涉及的工序时，你会以一种你从大规模制造商那里购买时绝不会有的方式珍惜它。”
Clothkits 的理念保持不变，Mawer 感到自豪的是，她的布料在伦敦或英格兰北部印制，且包装被控制在最低限度。

sentence_translations.translation: 那是1979年，我还不满五岁。

sentence_translations.sentence: The brand, founded in 1968, had by the late 1980s mostly vanished from people’s lives, but by a combination of determination and luck Kay Mawer brought it back.

sentence_translations.sentence: Clothkits was created by the designer Anne Kennedy, who came up with the ingenious idea of printing a pattern straight on to coloured fabric so that a paper pattern was not needed.

sentence_translations.sentence: It was accompanied by instructions that almost anyone could follow on how to cut the pieces out and sew them together.
